response.sql: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count FROM actor a LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id), total_films AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film) SELECT ac.actor_id, ac.film_count, ac.film_count / NULLIF(tf.film_count, 0) AS fraction_of_total, (ac.film_count - AVG(ac.film_count) OVER ()) / NULLIF(tf.film_count, 0) AS difference_from_average FROM actor_counts ac CROSS JOIN total_films tf ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, ac.actor_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: “Total” means all films in the catalog, so each actor’s fraction is the share of catalog films in which they are credited.

alternatives.interpretation: “Total” means all actor–film credits, so each fraction is an actor’s share of credits.
